notes.title: Kunlik 90 daqiqa tartibi
notes.body:
Dushanba–shanba har kuni 4 blok:
- **20 daq — Lug'at:** 4000 Essential Words, kuniga 10 so'z. Har bir so'zga o'zingiz haqingizda 1 ta gap.
- **40 daq — Navigate:** asosiy darslik (reading, listening, speaking, writing).
- **20 daq — Grammatika (Du/Chor/Ju) yoki Talaffuz (Se/Pay/Sha):** Azar Red va Pronunciation in Use.
- **10 daq — Writing:** yozasiz va chatga yuborasiz, xatolarni «Xatolar» sahifasiga qo'shasiz.
Yakshanba: 40 daqiqa — flashcard, xatolar daftari va mini test.
Qoida: muntazamlik tezlikdan muhimroq. Bir kun qolib ketsa, ikki kunni bir kunda qilmang — keyingi kundan davom eting.

notes.title: Navigate bilan qanday ishlash kerak
notes.body:
**Reading:** 1) 60 soniya ko'z yugurtiring — matn nima haqida? 2) Savollarni o'qib, kalit so'zlarni toping. 3) Matnni diqqat bilan o'qib, notanish iboralarni belgilang.
**Listening (3 marta):**
- 1-marta: to'xtatmasdan, umumiy g'oya.
- 2-marta: savollarga javob, kerak bo'lsa pauza.
- 3-marta: audioscript bilan (kitob oxirida). Eshitmagan so'zlarni belgilang.
**Speaking:** topshiriqqa 1–2 daqiqa diktofonga javob bering, qayta eshiting.
**Workbook:** Coursebook'dan kamida bir necha soat yoki 1 kun keyin bajaring.

notes.title: 1-hafta: Beginner tezkor tekshiruvi (85% qoidasi)
notes.body:
Siz B1 darajadagi matnni tushundingiz, shuning uchun Beginner'ni boshidan o'qimaymiz.
- Har bir Unit uchun faqat **Workbook**ni bajaring (Coursebook'siz).
- Javoblarni Answer key (p92) bilan tekshiring, foizni hisoblang va «Kun izohi»ga yozing.
- **85% va yuqori** → o'tkazib yuborasiz.
- **85% dan past** → shanba kuni o'sha Unit'ning Coursebook grammatikasini o'qib, xatolarni qayta bajarasiz.

notes.title: So'z yodlash: 4000 Essential Words
notes.body:
- So'zni tarjima bilan emas, **ta'rif + misol gap** orqali o'rganing.
- Audio bilan 3 marta ovoz chiqarib ayting.
- O'zingiz haqingizda **1 ta real gap** yozing. Misol: `afraid` → I am not afraid of making mistakes in English.
- Ikkinchi kuni: Exercise'lar + hikoyani ovoz chiqarib o'qish.
- Takrorlash: 1-kun, 2-kun, 4-kun, 7-kun, 14-kun (yakshanba flashcard).

notes.title: Azar va Pronunciation bilan ishlash
notes.body:
**Azar:** chart'da 3 narsaga qarang — **form** (qanday yasaladi), **meaning** (nima bildiradi), **use** (qachon ishlatiladi). Mashqlarni yozma bajaring, oxirida tekshiring. Keyin qoidani o'zingizga ovoz chiqarib tushuntiring va o'z hayotingizdan 3 ta gap yozing.
**Pronunciation in Use:** audio eshiting → pauza → spiker bilan bir xil tezlikda takrorlang (shadowing). O'z ovozingizni yozib, audio bilan solishtiring.

notes.title: Present Simple: he / she / it + -s
notes.body:
Diagnostikada: «Tom play football» deb yozdingiz.
**Qoida:** he, she, it (yoki bitta odam/narsa) bilan fe'lga **-s / -es** qo'shiladi.
- I play → He **plays**
- I watch → She **watches** (-ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o → -es)
- I study → It **studies** (undosh + y → -ies)
Inkor va savolda -s **does**ga o'tadi, fe'l esa oddiy qoladi:
- He **doesn't play**. (✗ doesn't plays)
- **Does** he **play**? (✗ Does he plays?)

notes.title: Neither of / Each of / Either of + birlik fe'l
notes.body:
Diagnostikada: «Neither of the students know» → to'g'ri: **knows**.
`Neither of`, `each of`, `either of`, `none of` + ko'plik ot → fe'l odatda **birlik** bo'ladi (rasmiy uslubda).
- **Neither** of my brothers **lives** in Tashkent.
- **Each** of the students **has** a book.
Shunga o'xshash: `The number of` + ko'plik → **has** (birlik). Lekin `A number of students` → **have** (ko'plik).

notes.title: Wish: hozirgi va o'tmishdagi pushaymonlik
notes.body:
Diagnostikada: «I wish I have studied harder last year» → to'g'ri: **had studied**.
- **Hozir** haqida → wish + **Past Simple**: I wish I **knew** more words. (Hozir bilmayman.)
- **O'tmish** haqida → wish + **Past Perfect**: I wish I **had studied** harder last year. (O'qimaganman.)
- **Kelajak / boshqa odamning harakati** → wish + **would**: I wish it **would** stop raining.
Batafsil: Mohida kursi Lesson 20 (Wishes) — 12-hafta rejasida.

notes.title: Gerund (-ing) yoki infinitive (to + fe'l)?
notes.body:
Diagnostikada: «She suggested to postpone» → to'g'ri: **postponing**.
**-ing bilan keladi:** suggest, enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, consider, recommend, admit, keep.
- I enjoy **reading**. She suggested **postponing** the meeting.
**to + fe'l bilan keladi:** want, decide, plan, hope, agree, refuse, promise, need, learn.
- I want **to learn** English. He decided **to stay**.
Batafsil: Mohida kursi Lesson 11–12 — 12-hafta rejasida.

notes.title: Not only … but also (inversion) — Band 7 struktura
notes.body:
Diagnostikada: «Not only he was late» → to'g'ri: **Not only was he late**.
Agar `Not only` gap **boshida** kelsa, yordamchi fe'l egadan **oldin** keladi (xuddi savoldagidek):
- **Not only was he** late, but he also forgot the documents.
- **Not only does** pollution harm health, but it also damages the economy.
Gap o'rtasida bo'lsa, inversion yo'q: He was **not only** late **but also** rude.
Hozir buni yodda saqlang — faol ishlatish B2 bosqichida.

notes.title: Fikr yozish uchun gap qoliplari
notes.body:
Fikrni yetkaza olmaslik — normal holat. Yechim: tayyor qoliplar. Faqat bo'sh joyni to'ldirasiz.
- **Fikr:** I prefer __ because __. / I think (that) __.
- **1-sabab:** One reason is that __.
- **Misol:** For example, __.
- **2-sabab:** Also, __. / Another reason is that __.
- **Qarshi fikr:** However, some people think __.
- **Xulosa:** In conclusion, I believe __.
Bilmagan so'zni o'zbekcha qavs ichida yozing: I like (tinch) places. Men tekshirganda inglizchasini aytaman.

notes.title: Paragraf tuzilmasi (4-haftadan boshlab)
notes.body:
Bitta paragraf = bitta asosiy fikr.
- **Topic sentence:** asosiy fikr (1 gap).
- **Supporting sentences:** 2 ta sabab, har biriga misol.
- **Concluding sentence:** fikrni boshqa so'zlar bilan qaytarish.
Bog'lovchilar: **and, but, because, so, also, however, for example, first, then, finally, in conclusion**.
O'sish rejasi: 1-hafta 3 gap → 2-hafta 5 gap → 4-hafta 80 so'z → 2-oy 100–120 so'z → 3-oy 150 so'z.

tests.name: Diagnostika: Grammar
tests.detail: Zamonlar yaxshi. Xatolar: neither of + fe'l, wish, not only inversion, suggest + -ing.

tests.name: Diagnostika: Reading
tests.detail: Oddiy va B1 matnlarni tushunadi; muammo — so'z boyligi.

tests.name: Diagnostika: Writing
tests.detail: Fikrni ingliz tilida ifodalash — eng zaif joy.
